recognize_zh: 流式圖中紅色母細胞群 CD10 一致陽性（10^1–10^2）、CD58 弱至中度陽性，形成與紫色 CD10 陰性正常細胞分開的緊密群；CD58 常用於 B-ALL 殘存疾病（MRD）與正常 hematogone 的區分。
features: Bivariate dot plot: CD10-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD58-FITC (y-axis), log scales
Red (blast-gated) population forms a tight cluster that is uniformly CD10-positive
Blasts express CD58 at dim-to-moderate intensity with a diagonal upward trend
Purple CD10-negative background population with overlapping CD58 intensity
Scattered red events in the CD10-negative region (likely gating overlap)
describe_en: This flow cytometry dot plot displays CD10 versus CD58. The gated blast population (red) forms a tight, uniformly CD10-positive cluster with dim-to-moderate CD58 expression, clearly separated from the CD10-negative background events (purple), which show similar to slightly lower CD58. The homogeneous CD10-positive population supports a precursor B-cell phenotype. CD58 overexpression relative to normal hematogones is a recognized leukemia-associated aberrancy in B-ALL MRD panels, but without a normal B-precursor reference population on this plot, the degree of overexpression cannot be judged from this image alone.

ddx.vs: Normal B precursors show a maturation continuum of CD10 with relatively lower CD58, whereas leukemic blasts tend to show brighter CD58 in a compact cluster.
CD10-positive mature B cells with bright CD20 and surface light-chain restriction, lacking CD34/TdT.
May be CD10-positive but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and lacks CD19/cCD79a.
